title: More Forms for '{il faut que}' and '{je veux que}' Phrases
description: More verb forms that appear after '{il faut que...}' and '{je veux que...}' phrases. vienne (come), parte (leave), puisse (can), sache (know), comprenne (understand). Essential for wishes and commands!
can_do: Use more special forms for complex expressions
Express wishes with motion and modal verbs

concepts.definition: These verbs change the same way after {il faut que} and phrases like it.

examples.fr: Il faut que tu saches ça.

concepts.definition: Use the special form after {que} in a phrase of need, wish or feeling. Everywhere else, use the ordinary form.
With {que} and a person after {il faut}, the verb changes. Without them, it does not.

examples.fr: Il faut que tu partes maintenant.
